text: in the @cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/Studio.tsx can u give me capability to merge layers together
resolution: Added a per-row 'merge' verb to the Studio OUTLINER (the layer list) so layers can be merged together. Each layer row now shows a Merge button that folds that layer down into the one above it (disabled on the topmost row). Implementation reuses the existing weld: generalized studioModel.mergeActive() into mergeDown(id) — the viewport 'merge → <target>' button and the new outliner verb now share one mergeMesh path so they can never diverge. Wired runAction('merge-down') → mergeDown, added 'merge-down' to LayerStripAction and a canMerge flag to LayerStripRowModel, and rendered the Merge button in GenericLayerRow gated on canMerge!==undefined so the other LayerStackStrip consumer (materials source) is unaffected. esbuild bundle compiles clean; the ship's LABEL MISMATCH/destroy is a pre-existing manifest.json capability drift from another session, unrelated to this change.
